name: Meta Business Suite / Facebook Creator Studio Adapter

config_schema.title: Meta Business Suite Config & HAR Import
config_schema.har_hint: Drop download-facebook.har here or select file (.har, .json) to auto-extract credentials and Comet parameters

fields.label: Meta Business Base URL
fields.description: Primary Meta Business Suite upstream URL

fields.label: Module Status
fields.description: Enable or disable Meta Business Suite requests

fields.label: Auto-Translate / Video Dubbing
fields.description: Enable multi-language auto-dubbing and translated audio metadata by default

fields.label: Page Access Token
fields.placeholder: EAAB... (optional direct Page Access Token override)
fields.description: Direct Meta Graph API Page Access Token or system user token

fields.label: Session Cookie
fields.placeholder: Leave empty to keep existing cookie (c_user, xs, datr)

fields.label: CSRF Token (fb_dtsg)
fields.placeholder: Leave empty to keep existing fb_dtsg
fields.description: Comet anti-CSRF token extracted from HAR or page payload

fields.label: Actor ID (av)
fields.description: Active acting identity or Page ID

fields.label: Target Page ID
fields.description: Default target Facebook Page for uploads and reels
